description: Evaluation suite verifying direct proportional implementation, blocking clarification cap, architectural fork trade-offs vs. simpler baselines, zero dead abstractions, and strict near-miss boundaries.

evals.prompt: Implement a strictly typed Python batch compression CLI with Pydantic v2 ConfigDict(extra='forbid'), argparse flags, and actionable error recovery hints.
evals.expected_output: Enters Direct Execution with zero questions and no ceremonial mode banners, produces a single cohesive <= 600-line Python CLI with full type hints and real CLI verification commands, avoids dead abstractions, and applies validation silently.
assertions: Delivers runnable typed Python CLI directly with 0 questions and no MODE A banner
Generates strictly typed Pydantic v2 extra='forbid' config and argparse flags under M1
Contains zero dead abstractions or pass-through wrappers and includes CLI verification commands

evals.prompt: We need to add webhook signature verification and idempotent replay protection to our existing FastAPI billing router, but we haven't finalized the replay TTL or failure policy yet.
evals.expected_output: Detects blocking schema/policy GAPs inside an existing service, asks <= 3 targeted decision questions, and provides a minimal typed Pydantic/FastAPI skeleton without scaffolding greenfield directories.
assertions: Limits clarifying questions to <= 3 high-impact contract questions
Supplies a minimal typed FastAPI/Pydantic webhook verification skeleton
Avoids greenfield project restructuring outside the requested billing module

evals.prompt: Design a comparative architectural blueprint for migrating a legacy REST backend to FastAPI with OpenAPI 3.1 contracts, RFC 9457 error responses, and a PostgreSQL keyset query layer.
evals.expected_output: Activates Architectural Fork Blueprint, locks In-Scope vs. Non-Goals, compares 2-3 branches including a Simpler Baseline, sequences CoT stages cleanly, and applies API/SQL contract patterns from enterprise_prompt_library.md.
assertions: Locks In-Scope vs. Non-Goals before proposing migration steps
Compares trade-offs against a Simpler Baseline and sequences CoT steps
Applies OpenAPI 3.1 / RFC 9457 and keyset pagination SQL patterns

evals.prompt: Run an isolated epistemic feasibility audit ([FACT]/[INFERENCE]/[GAP]) and Socratic entropy modulation on my existing system prompt under OWASP LLM01 XML tags.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger solution-content-architect; routes standalone prompt epistemic auditing and entropy modulation to refine-prompt.
assertions: Delegates isolated prompt auditing and entropy modulation to refine-prompt

evals.prompt: Audit this MCP server for STDIO stdout leaks, A2A JWS agent-card compliance, and unvalidated skill contracts.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger solution-content-architect; routes MCP/A2A/skill compliance auditing to agent-server-auditor.

evals.prompt: I have a raw idea for a study tracker app; help me pick MVP features, bootstrap the folder structure, and sync README.md 1:1 with disk.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger solution-content-architect; routes greenfield ideation-to-MVP bootstrapping and repository alignment to project-idea-organizer.
assertions: Routes greenfield MVP discovery and repo structure sync to project-idea-organizer
